name: Sovereign debt stress
summary: French 10-year yield held near 4.9% on 19–20 Nov, keeping the Bund spread close to the 150bp Alert line
state: France's 10-year yield rose back above 4.9% on 19 Nov, below October's 24-year high of 5.1%, with French bonds under fiscal pressure ahead of the 2027 presidential election and investors adding to bets on ECB rate rises (Trading Economics). That keeps the spread to Bunds close to the 150bp Alert line, but this run could not confirm a close above 150bp from two outlets, so the Alert is unconfirmed and the level is Watch. No failed G7 auction or emergency central-bank buying was found as of 21 Nov.
for_you: French borrowers and holders of French government debt are most exposed; higher sovereign yields tend to feed through to mortgage and corporate borrowing costs.
rubric_hit: Watch: France–Bund spread in 80–150bp band near upper line; Alert >150bp unconfirmed

sources.title: Trading Economics — French bond yields rise as ECB rate hike bets grow

why: When big governments struggle to borrow, it raises everyone's costs and can force sudden austerity or money-printing.
drivers: Deficits, auction demand, ratings actions, political shocks, long-end yields.

rubric.alert: Failed G7 auction, emergency central-bank purchases, France–Bund > 150bp, or Italy–Bund > 250bp.
rubric.watch: G7 30-year yields at multi-decade highs, a G7 downgrade, or France–Bund 80–150bp / Italy–Bund 150–250bp.
rubric.normal: Auctions orderly; France–Bund spread < 80bp; Italy–Bund < 150bp; no G7 downgrades this month.
